description: Rotated-variant obfuscation signature OpenSourceMalware observed starting April 2026 -- identical architecture to the v1 signature (same 4-layer shuffle cipher, same blockchain dead-drop C2, same BeaverTail second stage) with every unique fingerprint string rotated, assessed as an evasion response to the published v1 YARA rule. OpenSourceMalware has observed at least one repository re-infected with this variant after a prior v1-only cleanup, so a clean v1 scan does not establish a repository is free of PolinRider. Note: this v2 injection marker (global['_V']) is structurally similar to, but a separately reported and distinct indicator from, the global['_V'] string in this site's EtherHiding watchlist entry for the GTIG-reported JADESNOW downloader (a different malware family under different attribution) -- the resemblance is a shared low-level JS-obfuscation idiom, not an asserted link between the two campaigns.
